query: INSERT INTO user_totp (user_id, secret, setup_session, setup_started_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET secret = excluded.secret, setup_session = excluded.setup_session, setup_started_at = now() WHERE user_totp.enabled_at IS NULL AND (user_totp.setup_session = $3 OR user_totp.setup_started_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $4))
